description: Launch an interview round (async): every participant runs the discussion guide against the target URL in a real browser, and may call the allowed tools of MCP servers attached to the project (list_project_mcp_servers); then a report is synthesised. Requires at least one section with items and one participant. Poll get_interview / get_interview_report for progress (runs take several minutes).

interview_id.description: Interview UUID, from list_interviews or create_interview.

name: launch_interview

trigger_run_id.description: Background run id for this round. Track progress with get_interview, not this id.

title: Launch interview
